details: Automated Truing-Up analysis completed for Infopark FY 2024-25.

Overrode 'power_purchase_cost' from 1033.71 to 1033.71. Reason: The actual distribution loss of 2.86% is below the approved target of 4.23%, resulting in an efficiency gain of Rs. 14.65 Lakhs. As per Regulation 73(3) of the KSERC Tariff Regulations 2021, 2/3rd of the gain (Rs. 9.77 Lakhs) is passed to the licensee, making the approved PPC Rs. 1033.71 Lakhs.
